about_the_game:
Get ready for the craziest, most explosive magical battle that’s ever been seen! Old Farts and Fireballs – a 3D voxel-based PvP game pitting senile yet impossibly powerful wizards against each other on a sky-high island in a bid to show who’s the craziest of them all!

Forget modest elixirs and dusty spell books. Here, anarchy, dynamite and just flat-out magical lunacy rule! In Old Farts and Fireballs you play the robe of one of several crazy wizards who-somehow, for reasons unknown-find themselves at the end of the earth, on an island that floats among the clouds. And each of you has one goal: to become the, bloody heck, maddest!

Voxel Euphoria of Destruction:

Diving in into a lively detailed voxel world that’s made to be … broken. Every building, every rock, every bridge it’s all at the mercy of your spells. Want to turn an enemy fort into dust? No problem. Forge your way through a collapsing tower? You got it! The world’s not just destructible; its lives your chaos, making each and every battle into an oddball spectacle.

Up to 5 Mages Battle:

Every Game is unique: Compose your band of nutcases or challenge other players in dynamic battles for up to 5 warriors, pretty similar to the approach taken in games like Advance Wars. Small troops mean each warrior bears tremendous importance, and the pandemonium on the flying island will escalate with an increasing rate. You’d better watch out, guess your rivals’ next step, and make the best use of every feature of the setting.

An Arsenal of Magical Insanity:

Get ready for an incredible variety of spells! We’re not talking about your basic “fireballs” (though they’re here too, with a signature crazy twist)

Spirit of Rivalry and Madness:

This isn't just a fight; it's a contest to see who's the craziest magic user. Go wild, be bold, and ditch common sense. Show off your zaniest, most surprising spells to win and be named Maddest Mage!

The Flying Island:

Your battleground is a strange floating island packed with secret spots, dangerous falls, and things you can smash. Use your magic to get around, but remember: magic can destroy anything!
